s11_f00e: Comrade General.
You are more stubborn than I thought.
Look at you: such a threat to the enemy.
Do me a favor. Honor me with a personal visit to Moscow.
I would like to thank you myself.
Before you go anywhere, you should see this.
This tape arrived today.
'Send this tape if anything should happen to the Premier.'
If you are watching this, I suppose I am already dead.
I am lost... I do not know... how...
Oh, Mother Russia, I am beginning to forget how to speak.
Yuri! He has controlled my mind! He has killed me.
If I am dead now, command passes to you.
Send this tape as far and as widely as you can.
For the glory of Russia, for justice,
take my country back.
I think we both understand the truth now. Hmm?
Yuri has his own fortress outside Moscow. He is gathering an army.
But most of the army will follow your orders.
No... say no more, General.
They follow your orders now.
Even if we never speak again...
it has been an honor to serve you.
s11_p01e: These men work for me now.
s11_p03e: Yuri has rebuilt the Iron Curtain.
It will make his forces temporarily invulnerable.
s11_p04e: Comrade, no one can catch us by surprise now.
I have obtained the plans for the Psychic Sensor.
This device warns us of troop movements within its detection range.
At last, we can rest a little easier.
